notes:
Tasks: "More Time Asked" now lists only unfinished tasks whose request for more time is still waiting for an answer — once it is granted or refused, or the task is done, it leaves the list.

My Cashbook: when there is nothing to claim, tapping "Ask for reimbursement" now tells you why — for example the advance you still have in hand — instead of opening all your entries.

Employee Cashbook for the CEO and MD: it now shows just the advance decisions — no Approval tab and no advances waiting to be paid out, which are the accounts team's work. Advance requests are approved or declined one at a time.

Also: the in-app Help guide is updated.
